newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong high rise fire kills 37 - governor Patten.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong high rise fire kills 37 - governor Patten.

text.p: The confirmed death toll in a Hong Kong commercial building blaze has risen to 37 people and could increase, colonial Governor Chris Patten said on Thursday.
"There may be two other confirmed fatalities," Patten told Hong Kong's Legislative Council.
"We're still trying to identify bodies and relate those reported missing to those we already know have been killed but whose bodies have not yet been identified," he said.
Patten said 78 people had been injured and 39 people been reported missing.

The inferno flared up on Wednesday evening and raged for more than 20 hours, gutting seven floors of a 16-storey tower block in the "Golden Mile" shopping district of Kowloon, a popular tourist haunt.
